title: The deprecated unittest aliases have been removed
summary: Python 3.12 removed the long-deprecated unittest.TestCase aliases, such as assertEquals() and failUnless(), and assertDictContainsSubset(), so using them raises AttributeError.
replacement: The current TestCase methods: assertEqual(), assertNotEqual(), assertTrue(), assertFalse(), assertAlmostEqual(), assertNotAlmostEqual(), assertRegex(), assertNotRegex(), and assertRaises(); assertDictContainsSubset() has none

constraints: Keep the behavior of the test unchanged; each alias calls the method its replacement names.
assertDictContainsSubset() has no replacement, so its assertion must be rewritten by hand.

steps.title: Replace the alias
steps.instructions: Replace each reported alias with the current TestCase method that What's New in Python 3.12 names; rewrite an assertDictContainsSubset() call by hand, because it has no replacement.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings treated as errors when pytest is used.
